title: The green chain
logline: The green chain: rough lumber sliding down a moving table and the men pulling it off, from behind, a row of backs and gloves. The forty from the photo, working, none of them facing us.

panels.composition: A mill's green chain from the end: rough boards sliding along a moving table and a row of men from behind pulling them off onto stacks, gloves, the roof's skylights gray, sawdust as black spotting.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a lumber mill's green chain seen from the end with rough boards sliding along a moving table and a row of men seen from behind pulling them onto stacks, gray skylights above, no words
